title: ZeroOptimize
summary: Free some RAM and save power, with a way back to stock for every change
description:
ZeroOptimize shows the device's RAM, swap, load, clock and temperature live, and applies a few tweaks one at a time: smaller graphics memory (gpu_mem, needs a reboot), a higher swappiness for the compressed swap, a short allow-list of idle services (avahi, rpcbind, nfs-blkmap, automatic apt updates, man-db) and sleep for the USB network adapter. After each change it measures the gain in available RAM.

Every tweak records the original value first and can be put back to stock from the same screen, one by one (Enter on an ON tweak) or all at once (R). Your own services are never touched. Changes run through sudo: you type your sudo password on the device keyboard; it is never stored or logged.

Interface in French, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese (F2). Statically linked Rust build. Ideas inspired by cardputer-optimize; no code copied.
